documentation.title: Command Registration
documentation.standard:
Register commands with WP_CLI::add_command() under a vendor namespace: wp <vendor> <noun> [<verb>]. A bare name such as "list" collides with other plugins and with WP-CLI core commands. A class registered as a single word (wp acme) is a command group, which is allowed unless the word is a WP-CLI core command such as user or cache. Command name segments must be lowercase.
Requirement: A1 (MUST, error). Error codes: MissingNamespace, UppercaseSegment.

code.title: Invalid: Bare or core command name.
